cases.detail: Icarus rejects a variable element index before a packed structure member with a reference to index is not allowed in a constant expression and Array index expressions must be constant here, then aborts in collapse_array_indices. Both shared sources and an adapter-free source reproduce the compiler failure. IEEE 1800-2023 7.4.6 permits these variable indices of packed array variables; these are not indices of hierarchical instance scopes. The constant-index ascending case passes.
